_module.description: Physics system log configuration -- independent log instance for the physics thread, not sharing main thread log resources. Log files include dates to distinguish sessions. The level field supports runtime hot-reload.
_module.jolt_reference: N/A (project log layer is based on quill library)

_comment.logDir: Log directory path, string, default "./logs/physics", directory for physics thread log files
_comment.fileName: Log file base name, string, default "physics_engine", final filename = fileName_dateFormat.log
_comment.dateFormat: Date format, string, default "YYYY-MM-DD", used for the date portion in log filenames
_comment.level: Log level, string, "debug"|"info"|"warn"|"error", default "info", supports runtime hot-reload [D9]
_comment.maxFileSizeMb: Max file size (MB), int, >0, default 50, triggers size-based rotation when exceeded
_comment.maxBackupFiles: Number of backup files, int, >=0, default 10, oldest backup is deleted when exceeded
_comment.rotationFrequency: Time rotation strategy, string, ""|"daily"|"hourly"|"minutely", default ""(size-only rotation), consistent with engine::LogConfig defaults
_comment.rotationInterval: Rotation interval granularity, int, >0, default 1, hourly means every N hours, minutely means every N minutes
_comment.rotationTimeDaily: Daily rotation time, string, "HH:MM" format, default "00:00", takes effect when rotationFrequency="daily"
_comment.formatPattern: Log format pattern, string, default quill standard format: "%(time) [%(thread_id)] [%(log_level_short_code)] [%(logger)] %(message)"

_restart_note: Fields listed in requires_restart need a physics thread restart to take effect. The level field supports runtime hot-reload via ReloadLogLevel().
